beats.vo: AI just rewrote five jobs in advertising. And there's one it still can't touch.
beats.head: AI rewrote [g]5[/g] ad jobs. [r]1[/r] it can't.

beats.vo: Number one: the shoot. An ad that aired in the NBA Finals was made with Google's Veo 3, in about two days.
beats.head: #1 The [c]shoot[/c]

beats.vo: Number two: the first draft. Hundreds of headlines in seconds. A human picks the winner.
beats.head: #2 The [c]first draft[/c]

beats.vo: Number three: personalisation. Cadbury's AI ads put Shah Rukh Khan in front of more than two thousand local stores.
beats.head: #3 [c]Personalisation[/c]

beats.vo: Number four: the media buyer. Meta says its AI ad tools passed a sixty billion dollar run rate.
beats.head: #4 The [c]media buyer[/c]

beats.vo: Number five: testing. Buyers expect about forty percent of video ads to be built with gen AI by 2026.
beats.head: #5 [c]Testing[/c]

beats.vo: And the one job AI can't do? Taste.
beats.head: The one it can't: [g]TASTE[/g]

beats.vo: Coca-Cola's AI holiday ads drew backlash two years in a row. The tools worked. People still asked: where's the feeling?
beats.head: Tools: fine. [r]Feeling?[/r]

beats.vo: So learn the tools, and keep the taste.
beats.head: Learn the tools. [g]Keep the taste.[/g]
